provider_if_inherited: Email and file suite provider; accounting SaaS provider
implementation_statement: The owner holds the only user account in each SaaS tenant; the tax accountant has a read-only accounting account. The drafting subcontractor used a folder share, not an account; it was removed on 2026-07-21. Gap: no periodic review of accounts and shares.
regulatory_driver: N22-R01 (CIP-004-7 R6 Parts 6.1 and 6.3 via SSA-A (2) and (4))

implementation_statement: The file suite enforces the sharing settings the owner chooses. Gap: the shared "Projects" folder gave the drafting subcontractor access to Client A BCSI from 2025-03-03 to 2026-07-21, and an "anyone with the link" share on a Client B folder stayed open until 2026-07-23. Client folders are now owner-only.
regulatory_driver: N22-R01 (CIP-011-3 R1 Part 1.2 via SSA-A (1); CIP-004-7 R6 Part 6.1 via SSA-A (2))

implementation_statement: The owner works in the laptop administrator account every day, including email and web browsing. A standard daily account, with the administrator account used only for installs, is planned by 2026-09-30.
regulatory_driver: N22-R01 (CIP-003-9 R2 Att. 1 Sec. 5.2 via VAA-B (1))

implementation_statement: Laptop locks after 5 minutes idle; phone after 30 seconds. Both require the passcode or password to unlock.

Client B enables each vendor session on request, authenticates with a named account and MFA, and disables the session afterward (Client B's CIP-003-9 Section 6 methods). Owner responsibility: request each session, connect only from the business laptop, protect the credentials. Gap: no written usage rules; the gateway password was saved in the browser.
evidence: Client B session approvals (5 in 2026); browser password store review
regulatory_driver: N22-R01 (CIP-003-9 R2 Att. 1 Sec. 6.1 to 6.3 via VAA-B (3) and (4))

implementation_statement: Client A portal and Client B gateway are used under each client's terms. Gap: no list of which external systems may hold which client information; Client C data was uploaded to an AI SaaS that was never approved (P10).

The owner completes Client A's annual security awareness and BCSI handling module (last 2025-10-20). Gap: no other security training; no phishing awareness. An annual course plus Client A's module, due 2026-10-20, is planned.

control_name: Audit Record Review, Analysis, and Reporting
implementation_statement: No one has reviewed the email and file suite sign-in history or file sharing activity. Starting 2026-10, the owner will review both on the first business day of each month and log the review.

No register of client information held, its location, and its return or destroy date. A client information register (one row per client data set) is planned by 2026-10-31 and becomes the basis for SSA-A (7) certifications.
regulatory_driver: N22-R01 (CIP-011-3 R1 Part 1.1 via SSA-A (1) and (7)); CEII NDA (18 CFR 388.113(h)(2))

implementation_statement: The BIA (P05), POL-01 section 11, and the P08 runbook form the contingency plan. Gap: no standby engineer and no sealed emergency sheet yet (due 2026-12-31).
Files in the suite have 30 days of version history (provider). Owner responsibility: the laptop's local settings databases and software license files have no backup, and no restore has been tested.
evidence: Suite version history; laptop folder review

provider_if_inherited: Email and file suite provider; accounting SaaS provider
implementation_statement: The email suite administrator account is the owner's account and uses SMS codes. Gap: the accounting SaaS owner account (which controls bank details on invoices) has no MFA. Phishing-resistant or app-based MFA for both by 2026-09-15.

provider_if_inherited: Email and file suite provider; Client A; Client B
implementation_statement: Client A and Client B enforce MFA on their own systems. The email suite uses SMS codes, which phishing kits can relay. The personal photo cloud that received control house photos has no MFA (P01 R-005).
Passwords are saved in the browser, and two are reused across business services. A password manager with unique passphrases is planned by 2026-09-15.
No written reporting procedure. The 2026-07-22 notice to Client A was made ad hoc, within 24 hours of discovery. The P08 notification matrix and printed client contact sheet are due 2026-09-30.
regulatory_driver: N22-R01 (CIP-013-2 R1 Parts 1.2.1 and 1.2.2 via SSA-A (5); VAA-B (5)); CEII NDA (18 CFR 388.113(h)(2))

implementation_statement: The P08 runbook was adopted 2026-08-31. Gap: not yet walked through with the IT technician (due 2026-09-30).
Paper is cross-cut shredded. Gap: no procedure to wipe USB drives or retire devices, and no return or destroy certification for two Client A projects that ended in 2025.

USB drives are scanned at Client B's kiosk before use there. Gap: the same drives hold personal files and are not scanned before other client work. Two dedicated, labeled drives for settings files are planned by 2026-09-30.
regulatory_driver: N22-R01 (CIP-003-9 R2 Att. 1 Sec. 5.3 via VAA-B (2))

implementation_statement: The drafting subcontractor has a general subcontract with a confidentiality clause but no access agreement naming client security information. A signed access agreement (no BCSI or CEII without written client approval; return and delete on request) is planned by 2026-09-30.
First risk assessment completed 2026-07-24 using SP 800-30 Rev. 1 (P01). Reviewed each July and after major changes.
regulatory_driver: Business need (POL-01 4.3); supports every SSA-A and VAA-B item

implementation_statement: The email suite provider's SOC 2 Type 2 report was reviewed 2026-07-23 (P09). Gap: no vendor list; the accounting SaaS, the AI forecasting SaaS, the consumer chatbot, the personal photo cloud, and the drafting subcontractor were never reviewed.

The laptop host firewall is on. Gap: the home Wi-Fi is shared with household devices and the router admin password is the default. A separate business network (router guest or second network) is planned by 2026-10-31.

provider_if_inherited: Email and file suite provider; Client A; Client B
implementation_statement: The file suite, the Client A portal, and the Client B gateway encrypt traffic in transit (inherited). The owner sends Client A BCSI only through the portal.

Laptop full-disk encryption on since 2025-01 with the recovery key stored offline; phone encrypted by its passcode; CEII kept in an encrypted archive; the suite provider encrypts stored files (inherited).
Automatic OS updates are on. Gap: the relay settings and analysis software are updated by hand and were two versions behind; nobody watches the vendors' security advisories.
regulatory_driver: N22-R01 (CIP-003-9 R2 Att. 1 Sec. 5.2 via VAA-B (1); CIP-013-2 R1 Part 1.2.4 via SSA-A (6))

implementation_statement: The built-in antivirus runs real-time and scheduled scans with automatic signature updates. Client B checks its update level before each connection.
evidence: Antivirus status page (P07 test); Client B checklists
regulatory_driver: N22-R01 (CIP-003-9 R2 Att. 1 Sec. 5.2.1 via VAA-B (1))
